rename.from: When pendingBytes is high, SslHandler tries to allocate a huge outNet buffer.
rename.to: When the number of pending unencrypted bytes is high, SslHandler tries to allocate a huge outNet buffer.

body: A workaround is probably for a user to split the large buffer into multiple 16KiB ones, although I didn't try yet.
@trustin let me check. That said don't you think we will have the same problem even when split the buffer as the "flush" will not happen until we processed everything in the `pendingWrites` queue ?

@normanmaurer That's a good question. To be precise, I guess it has to be a one large buffer. I wrote a large buffer on HTTP/1 and HTTP/2 connection and the problem occurred only on HTTP/1 which is likely due to HTTP/2's automatic segmentation.
@trustin most likely this is due the fact that such a large buffer will be allocated from outside the pool.

issue.title: SslHandler fails io.netty.util.internal.OutOfDirectMemoryError when used with OpenSSL

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
### Expected behavior
No errors when run netty with SslHandler+OpenSSL and sample data size of 20 mb.

### Actual behavior
OpenSSL fails with "io.netty.util.internal.OutOfDirectMemoryError", see https://gist.github.com/floragunncom/c9e46f1e80c047d093995979c8b0fcbc
It works with reduced amount data (on my machine it seems failing above 8 or 9 mb) 
Java SSL works in every case

### Steps to reproduce
Run the provided code:
`java -Xmx4g -jar  -Dopenssl target/netty-sslslow-1.0-jar-with-dependencies.jar`

Running the tests with fewer data (for example with 5mb instead of 20mb) works:
`java -Xmx4g -jar  -Ddata=5 -Dopenssl target/netty-sslslow-1.0-jar-with-dependencies.jar`

### Minimal yet complete reproducer code (or URL to code)
https://github.com/floragunncom/netty-memleak/tree/bigsslslow (see README)
https://github.com/floragunncom/netty-memleak/releases/tag/slow1

### Netty version
4.1.9.Final
tcnative 2.0.0.Final

### JVM version (e.g. `java -version`)
Java Version: 1.8.0_102 Oracle Corporation
JVM Impl.: 25.102-b14 Oracle Corporation Java HotSpot(TM) 64-Bit Server VM

### OS version (e.g. `uname -a`)
Mac OS X x86_64 10.10.5

This issue is related to https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/6571
